parent.content:
The bunny, a known issue, hopped into the aura cage of the User. This hadn't been accounted for, so the bunny had no texture map. This made it colourless amongst all the remembered light.

What was interesting about this known issue was that it was as close to conflict as could be imagined, even though this island of light -before-movement was full of lighthouses and miles of prim cliffline. It was a bunny-haunted world.

()
parent.title: Colourless hopping

parent.readme: Found in a library of Helioseismology (about how the sun works). A proposal that a flare is a kind of syntax of working out if the consequences of the flare are up or down, and that feelings of warmth are a loss function.

persons.bio: In conformity with the late author's wish, her Board of Literary Management asks us to record that, in 1941, Laura (Riding) Jackson renonunced, on grounds of linguistic principle, the writing of poetry; she had come to hold that 'poetry obstructs general attainment to something better in our linguistic way-of-life than we have."
